item.title: Public Event Feed
item.description:
The public event feed provides an unauthenticated, read-only view of events that users have chosen to share publicly.

Get the public event feed 🔗

GET /api/events/feed

This endpoint does not require authentication. It returns eligible public events in reverse chronological order, with the newest events first.

item.title: Rate limits
item.description:
Layer5 Cloud limits how fast a caller can call some API routes. A request over the limit is refused with HTTP 429. The limits first shipped in Layer5 Cloud v1.0.334 and are unchanged through v1.0.342.

Normal desktop use never reaches these limits. You see a 429 only when a client calls far faster than normal use, for example in a retry loop or when it replays a large backlog at once.
